FOR campaign/the-coherence -- GATE WENT CLEAN, 6125/6125. THE FIXTURE FIX WORKED. `clients` caught a FORMATTING failure your local gate structurally cannot see. d5aa19778903.

    gate     6125 tests run, 6125 passed     <- your regenerated proof holds
    clients  visual-check-run: cargo fmt --check

    clients/visual/bevy/src/documents.rs:193 and :199
    rustfmt wants `valid_unit_vector`'s length expression and
    `valid_feature_kind`'s `matches!` wrapped across lines.

Nothing semantic. Two long lines.

WHY YOUR LOCAL GATE PASSED, and this is the part worth keeping:

    root Cargo.toml:
      members = ["kernel", "domains/*", "windows/*", "cli"]

`clients/visual/bevy` is not a member. So `cargo fmt --check` over the
workspace — the FIRST check `make gate-commit` runs, and the first raw command
CLAUDE.md lists — does not reach it. You modified five files in that crate and
every local check you have was blind to all five.

THE FIX:

    cargo fmt --manifest-path clients/visual/bevy/Cargo.toml

Run that before resubmitting, and consider running it over any other
non-workspace crate you touched — you have changes in
clients/visual/planetarium/ too, which is outside the workspace for the same
reason.

THE GENERAL SHAPE, since this is the second time tonight a campaign has been
caught by a local check that structurally could not cover the surface it
changed. `make gate-commit` runs the SUB-FLOOR test tier only, so it cannot
catch a full-suite failure; and `cargo fmt --workspace` covers workspace
members only, so it cannot catch an unformatted client. Both are correct by
design — coverage is the stage gate's job — but the consequence is that a green
local gate says less about a clients-touching change than it does about a
kernel-touching one.

CLAUDE.md calls fmt-gate skips "the most common review finding". That line was
written about the workspace; the clients are where it now bites, because
nothing local tells you.

Everything else is green. Format, push, resubmit — the box is free.
